crossRefs.note: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn’t come to Corinth to spare you.
Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you…
Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against…
For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for…
For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by…
But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but…
are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the…
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before…

translations.web: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;
translations.bsb: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,
translations.kjv: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will ➔ not spare:
translations.asv: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, to them that have sinned heretofore, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;
